research.name: Voxlet UI
research.note: Animated React components and blocks such as a cursor-following magic wand and a Matter.js gravity tag cloud.

effects: Magic Wand: a floating wand follows the cursor and reveals images inside tiles
Gravity Box: a physics tag cloud built on Matter.js
Space Box with stars and shooting stars on hover

unverified: The component source is in the public repository voxletlabs/voxlet-ui (license reported as NOASSERTION by GitHub); that repository has not been researched yet.
The site now lives at https://ui.voxletstudio.com/ (redirect from voxlet-ui.vercel.app).
